author: Wilkie Collins
scope: complete full-length public-domain novel (1868), about 25x the previous short-story demo; exploratory functional run, not a benchmark
questions: Who took the Moonstone out of Rachel Verinder's sitting-room on the night it disappeared, and what evidence finally proves how it was taken?
How did the Moonstone travel from the Verinder house into Godfrey Ablewhite's hands and then to Mr. Luker in London?
Why did Rosanna Spearman hide a tin box in the Shivering Sand, and what did it contain?
